name: eventflow
description: EventFlow - Sistem manajemen acara dan penjadwalan proyek (multi-pengguna, organisasi, tugas, Gantt, PERT, CPM)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,brightyellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: concurrently -n FRONTEND-TEST,BACKEND-TEST -c blue,brightyellow "npm run test --prefix frontend" "npm run test --prefix backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.prepare: cd backend && npm pkg set scripts.prepare="prisma generate" 2>/dev/null || true
